4) Track maximum distance and corresponding city pair. Given dataset includes Honolulu, Hawaii (21.3156, -157.8581). The farthest in this limited set will be either with Quincy, MA or Braintree, MA; their longitudes are nearly identical and very far from Honolulu.

6) The loop updates max_distance when a larger value is found; finally, it alphabetically orders the two selected city names and prints them, along with the distance.
7) Program prints the pair and distance.
